title: Restart old terminals before support ends
body:
In the near future Farhelm will drop support for old style terminals that used to be based on tmux.

If you have such terminals, you will receive a notification from the relevant sessions in the left-hand sidebar. You must
restart or replace those as instructed, or a future release will forcibly terminate them.

If you receive no such notifications in the left-hand sidebar, there is no action required.

For more information, see https://farhelm.io/docs/using/new-terminals/
